items.name: OYA-OQS
items.title: Liouvillian Lieb-Schultz-Mattis Constraints in Open Quantum Systems
items.description: Local, translationally invariant Lindbladians with strong U(1) symmetry and a unique steady state in a fixed-charge sector exhibit asymptotically gapless modes in the thermodynamic limit: long-wavelength modes at any filling, plus additional modes at wave vectors set by non-integer filling.

items.name: ssb-qme
items.title: Strong Quantum Mpemba Effect via Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking in Open Systems
items.description: Spontaneous symmetry breaking provides a generic mechanism for the strong quantum Mpemba effect without delicate state engineering, for discrete or continuous, strong or weak symmetries. It creates slow modes in definite symmetry sectors: tunneling modes for discrete symmetries and Nambu-Goldstone modes for continuous ones. States in the steady-state symmetry sector bypass these modes and relax rapidly, while closer states overlapping the slow manifold relax slowly.
